title: Terms of Use
body:
Version 1.2 · effective 27 August 2026 · applies to all users of Urb TecTrack™

1. What this platform is
Urb TecTrack™ is operated by Urbeno Private Limited (“Urbeno”, “we”, “us”) to record and track the collection, transport, receipt, processing and certification of end-of-life electrical and electronic equipment. It is a record-keeping and communication tool. It does not itself constitute a contract for recycling services — the commercial agreement between your organisation and Urbeno governs that relationship and prevails over anything shown here if the two ever disagree.

2. Who may use it
Access is granted to named individuals by Urbeno at the request of an authorised representative of your organisation. Accounts are personal. You may not share credentials, and you are responsible for activity carried out under your login. Notify us promptly at info@urbeno.in if you believe an account has been compromised or if a colleague leaves and should lose access.

3. What you see
Client users see only records belonging to their own organisation, and only the sites their account is scoped to. Certain internal operating records — including the material receipt note raised at our factory gate — are visible to Urbeno staff only. This is deliberate: those documents govern our internal custody of material and are not part of your compliance file.

4. Accuracy of what you enter
Weights, quantities, item descriptions and reference numbers you provide when raising a request are treated as declarations. Approximate figures are expected at the request stage; the weight used for invoicing and for every compliance document is the net weight recorded at collection, either on a weighbridge or, where site conditions prevent that, by a manual method recorded with its reason. Where the invoiced weight differs from the weighed net, the difference and its explanation are recorded against the invoice.

5. Documents issued through this platform
• Form 6 manifests are issued under Rule 12 of the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022, one per invoice.
• Certificates of Destruction are prepared outside the platform, signed, and uploaded here. Several may be issued against a single request where material belongs to different departments.
• Material receipt notes are internal gate documents and are retained by Urbeno.
Documents downloaded from this platform are true copies of the records held by Urbeno. If a discrepancy ever arises between a downloaded copy and our retained original, the original governs.

6. Service levels
Urbeno targets issue of a Certificate of Destruction within thirty (30) days of material being received at the processing facility. This target is measured and displayed against every consignment. It is a service commitment, not a warranty, and does not apply where processing is delayed by matters outside our reasonable control, including incomplete documentation from your side, regulatory hold, or force majeure.

7. Payment and closure
Invoices fall due according to the payment terms agreed with your organisation and recorded on your profile. Once those terms elapse on an unpaid invoice, this platform may send payment reminders until the invoice is settled. A request cannot be marked complete in the platform until the invoice raised against it is paid in full.

8. Availability
We aim to keep the platform available at all times but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Planned maintenance is notified in advance where practical. Operations continue during any outage; records are brought up to date once access is restored.

9. Acceptable use
• Use the platform only for managing your own e-waste consignments with Urbeno.
• Do not attempt to access records belonging to another organisation.
• Do not upload malicious files, or content you have no right to share.
• Do not scrape, resell or republish platform data without our written agreement.

10. Intellectual property
The platform, its design and the Urbeno and Recycling Heroes™ marks belong to Urbeno Private Limited. Your data — your consignment records and the documents issued to you — remains yours, and you may export it at any time from the Reports section.

11. Limitation of liability
Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited under applicable law. Subject to that, Urbeno is not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential loss arising from use of the platform, and our aggregate liability in connection with the platform itself is limited to correcting the records concerned. Liability for the recycling services themselves is governed by your service agreement with Urbeno.

12. Changes
We may update these Terms as the platform develops. Material changes are notified to registered users by email and/or on next sign-in. The version and effective date shown at the top of this page always reflect the terms currently in force. Continued use after notice constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms, unless applicable law requires explicit re-acceptance.

13. Governing law and jurisdiction
These Terms are governed by the laws of India. The courts at Bengaluru, Karnataka shall have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to any mandatory consumer or data-protection remedies available under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

title: Privacy & Data Notice
body:
Version 1.2 · effective 27 August 2026 · Urbeno Private Limited

1. Scope
This Privacy & Data Notice explains how Urbeno Private Limited collects, uses, stores and protects personal data when you use Urb TecTrack™, in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA) and applicable e-waste regulations.

2. What we hold
For platform users: name, work email, phone number where supplied, organisation and site assignments, role, and a record of your activity in the platform.
For consignments: material descriptions, weights, photographs, vehicle and driver details where recorded, site contacts, and compliance documents issued to your organisation.
Where device serial numbers or asset tags are captured, we hold those identifiers and the sanitisation method applied. We do not access, copy or retain the contents of any storage media entrusted to us.

3. Why we hold it
We use personal data to:
• Provide access to Urb TecTrack and operate the recycling service you have engaged us for;
• Issue manifests, certificates and related compliance documentation;
• Meet record-keeping obligations under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022 and the conditions of our CPCB registration and State Pollution Control Board authorisation;
• Communicate about consignments, invoices, account security and platform updates;
• Maintain security, prevent misuse and enforce our Terms of Use.

4. Legal basis
Processing is based on performance of our contract with your organisation, compliance with legal obligations, and your consent where required (including acceptance of this Notice on first use of the platform).

5. Where data is stored
Production platform data is hosted within India. We do not transfer platform personal data outside India without your organisation’s written agreement or unless required by law.

6. How long we keep it
• Consignment records, manifests and receipt notes — at least five (5) years (Rule 12(4), E-Waste Rules).
• Certificates of Destruction — ten (10) years.
• Activity and audit records — seven (7) years.
• Sign-in and security logs — one (1) year, unless longer retention is required for investigation.
• Password-reset codes — until used or expired (typically fifteen minutes).

7. Sharing
We do not sell personal data. We share data only with authorised Urbeno staff, your organisation’s named users (within their access scope), service providers that host or operate the platform under contract, and regulators or courts when legally required.

8. Your rights (DPDPA)
You may request access to personal data we hold about you, correction of inaccurate data, and erasure where we are not required to retain it for legal or contractual reasons. You may withdraw consent where processing is consent-based, without affecting prior lawful processing.
Contact info@urbeno.in with the subject line “DPDPA request”. We will respond within thirty (30) days. You may also use the query thread on a relevant consignment for operational matters.

9. Security
Access is by individual account with a password. Passwords are stored only in encrypted form. Sessions expire after inactivity. Accounts lock after repeated failed sign-in attempts. Material changes to records are written to an audit trail showing who made the change and when.

10. Cookies
The platform stores a session identifier and your interface preferences in your browser. It does not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

11. Grievances
For privacy concerns or grievances under the DPDPA, write to info@urbeno.in. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may refer the matter to the Data Protection Board of India as provided under applicable law.

12. Changes
We may update this Notice when our practices or the law change. Material updates are notified on sign-in and may require renewed acceptance. The version shown on this page is the version in force.

title: Compliance Notice
body:
Regulatory basis on which Urbeno Private Limited operates as an authorised e-waste recycler

Authorisations
• CPCB EPR registration — CPCB/EPR/2022/KA/00817
• KSPCB authorisation — KSPCB/HWM/AUTH/2024-27/1142
• R2v3 certification — R2V3-2024-IN-0341
• ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 (where applicable to listed facilities)
• GST — 29AABCU1234R1ZX

Processing sites
Material is processed only at facilities authorised for the category concerned. Each site carries its own consent order, authorised category list and capacity limits. Urb TecTrack warns — and records an override with approver — before a category is processed beyond its authorised annual capacity.

Documents you are entitled to
• A Form 6 manifest for each invoice, issued under Rule 12 of the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022.
• A Certificate of Destruction for material processed (one or more per request where departments differ).
• Weighment evidence for each vehicle, or a recorded reason where a weighbridge could not be used.
• Sustainability and impact statements, with methodology published alongside figures.

Environmental claims
Figures in sustainability and Recycling Heroes™ sections are computed from completed consignments using published conversion factors cited in the methodology document. They are not carbon credits, offsets or tradable instruments and have not been registered with a crediting body.

Raising a concern
Compliance queries, facility visit requests, or concerns about how a consignment was handled should be sent to info@urbeno.in or our published support number. Facility visits can be arranged with reasonable notice.
